identificationModule.briefTitle: Raltitrexed-based Chemotherapy Plus Bevacizumab in Retreated Patients With Advanced Colorectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of Raltitrexed-based Chemotherapy Plus Bevacizumab in Retreated Patients With Advanced Colorectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The objective is to investigate the efficacy and safety of raltitrexed-based chemotherapy plus bevacizumab in the treatment of advanced colorectal cancer

armGroups.label: Raltitrexed and Irinotecan（RALIRI） plus Bevacizumab(AVASTIN)
armGroups.description: Irinotecan:250mg/m2 iv,90min,d1, Raltitrexed:3.0mg/m2,iv,15min,d1, Bevacizumab:7.5mg/kg iv,30min,d1,q3w. Maintenance: Raltitrexed(3.0mg/m2,iv,15min,d1,q3w)+Bevacizumab(7.5 mg/kg q3w)

armGroups.label: Raltitrexed and Oxaliplatin（RALOX） plus Bevacizumab(AVASTIN)
armGroups.description: Oxaliplatin:130mg/m2 iv,120min,d1, Raltitrexed:3.0mg/m2,iv,15min,d1, Bevacizumab:7.5mg/kg iv,30min,d1,q3w. Maintenance: Raltitrexed(3.0mg/m2,iv,15min,d1,q3w)+Bevacizumab(7.5 mg/kg q3w)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of participants experiencing grade 3-5 adverse events

locations.facility: The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University
